description: This file defines a mock implementation of the Fan Control Cluster, including attributes and methods to manage and simulate fan modes for testing purposes within a device cluster context.

classes.name: MockFanControlCluster
classes.description: A mock class representing the Fan Control Cluster with attributes to simulate fan modes and their management.

classes.name: FanMode
classes.description: An enumeration defining possible fan modes: off, low, medium, high, on, auto, and smart.

methods.name: setFanMode
methods.description: Sets the current fan mode and sends an attribute report if the mode has changed.

methods.name: getAttributeData
methods.description: Retrieves the attribute data for a given AttributeInfo object, responding with encoded byte data.

methods.name: get8BitValue
methods.description: Converts an integer value into a single-byte array for attribute data encoding.
